channel.title: Manish Jha - War Correspondent & Journalist
channel.description: Award-winning war correspondent and Executive Editor at TV9 Bharatvarsh covering international conflicts, diplomacy, and global affairs from 25+ countries.

item.title: International Conflict Reporting and War Correspondence
item.description: Award-winning coverage of major international conflicts including Ukraine War Coverage (2022-2025), China-Taiwan tensions, and Middle Eastern affairs. Experienced war correspondent with 20+ years in conflict zones.
item.content:encoded:
Extensive coverage of international conflicts and geopolitical tensions:

  • Ukraine War Coverage - Donbass, 2022-2025
  • China & Taiwan Relations - Beijing, Taipei, 2023-2025
  • US Presidential Elections and UNGA Coverage - 2019-2025
  • South Asian Affairs - Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka
item.author: manish@manishjha.com

item.title: Russia's Honest View Award 2025 - Recognition for Unbiased Journalism

item.content:encoded:

item.title: Executive Editor at TV9 Bharatvarsh - Leading International Journalism
